name: structure
description: Level 5: structure. Lower level numbers win.

rules.rationale: One function or one section per chunk. Longer units retrieve worse because the vector averages two topics.
A little overlap so a function split at the boundary is still findable from either side.
Shorter than this is a fragment, not a unit of meaning.
Bump this when the tables change, so an old database is refused instead of half-read.
